attempts.summary: Set up a LUKS2-encrypted XFS volume on node1, backed by a 2G sparse file loop-mounted at a fixed /dev/loop0, keyed by a root-only keyfile, that automatically unlocks and mounts at /srv/secure on every boot via systemd (secure-loop-setup.service -> systemd-cryptsetup@secure.service -> srv-secure.mount, pulled in by local-fs.target). Verified end-to-end across an actual node restart.
